_comment: All bytes are 0x-hex, lower case; uint values are JSON numbers. Generated by clients/clientkeys/scripts/pqvault-vectors.mjs (src/pqvault.js); never edit by hand. Random inputs are fixed: rnd(name, n) = the first n bytes of keccak256("scaas/pqvault/vectors/<name>/0") ‖ keccak256("scaas/pqvault/vectors/<name>/1") ‖ …; the labels are in the generator. Source: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-17-pqvault.md (§5.2–§5.4, §5.15, §6) and docs/contracts/pqvault.md. UNAUDITED. Keys (spec §6.1–§6.5, §6.10). kemKeys: as PqChat's (vectors/pqchat/keys.json): kemPk = 0x01 ‖ ML-KEM-1024 ek ‖ X25519 pk. wraps: ss = the scheme-1 combiner of encaps(kemPk, mlkemM, x25519Secret); kek = HKDF-SHA-256(ss, empty salt, "scaas/pqvault/v1/wrap" ‖ vaultId ‖ epochId ‖ member ‖ be64 keyId ‖ 0x01 ‖ keccak256(kemPk), 32); sealedKey = AES-256-GCM(kek, 0^96, K_e, aad vaultId ‖ epochId ‖ member ‖ be64 keyId); epoch 0's epochId is the vaultId. epochs: K_e = rnd("K_e/<epoch>"); P_k = pass.json's row of the epoch (null when passKdf = 0); K_v = HKDF-SHA-256(K_e ‖ P_k, empty, "scaas/pqvault/v1/vkey" ‖ vaultId ‖ epochId ‖ be16 passKdf, 32); kInfo = HKDF(K_v, "scaas/pqvault/v1/info" ‖ vaultId ‖ epochId); sealedInfo = infoNonce ‖ AES-256-GCM-SIV(kInfo, infoNonce, pt = padInfo(json): pad to at least the 1,024-B bucket, F12), empty AAD, json the canonical JSON of info; prev: kPrev = HKDF(K_v, "scaas/pqvault/v1/prev" ‖ vaultId ‖ epochId ‖ prevEpochId); keyWrap = nonce ‖ AES-256-GCM-SIV(kPrev, nonce, K_v(prev), aad "scaas/ua/v1/keywrap" ‖ u8 usage (Derive = 1) ‖ vaultId ‖ epochId ‖ prevEpochId), 60 B. usages: Derive 1, Data 2, KeyWrap 3 (handle metadata, never in a derivation's info); each row a call refused by its named error (AppKeyUsage: a handle of another usage; KeyWrapAad: seal / open of an AAD led by the key-wrap label; AeadOpen: a failed tag); sealOutput = nonce ‖ AES-256-GCM-SIV(kPrev's bytes as Data, nonce, plaintext, aad ctx), which openKey refuses. refusals: a wrong prev key (it opens, then fails the named epoch's sealedInfo: PrevKeyWrong) and a keyWrap opened under another epoch's K_v.

usages.name: open with a KeyWrap handle (a Data open of a keyWrap)
a keyWrap opened as data by a Data handle of kPrev's bytes
seal with an AAD led by the key-wrap label
openKey of a seal output under kPrev's bytes

refusals.name: a keyWrap carrying a wrong key: it opens, then fails the sealedInfo of the epoch it names
keyWrap opened under another epoch's K_v
